guard: A late turn-yield after the deadline deny has committed names the terminal the goal reached, never not-found.

mutations.name: a late yield after the deadline committed hears not-found instead of the deny
mutations.replace: if (settled.settled !== undefined) return { goalId, state: settled.settled.state };
mutations.expectRed: a yield after the deny committed, before the index drop, is told the turn ended failed, never `not-found`
mutations.cell: a yield after the deny committed, before the index drop, is told the turn ended failed, never `not-found`
mutations.note: #1262. After commitTurnDeadline deletes pending (the latch, before the terminal CAS) the only in-memory answer a late yield could find was turnAcceptances.settled. When that field was not yet written, or a concurrent sweep dropped it, the yield heard not-found for a deny the run already has. The durable terminal is the answer; the index drop is not the cause (the yield path never consults it).
